name: Ulysses S. Grant
role: Civil War general, U.S. president from 1869 to 1877
contribution: The 18th president of the United States, serving from 1869 to 1877, and was the Commanding General of the Union Army.
legacy: In 1863, he led the Vicksburg campaign that gave Union forces control of the Mississippi River and dealt a major strategic blow to the Confederacy.
image_credit: Brady-Handy Photograph Collection, Library of Congress · Public domain

checks.lead: Ulysses S. Grant (born Hiram Ulysses Grant; April 27, 1822 – July 23, 1885) was the 18th president of the United States, serving from 1869 to 1877, and was the Commanding General of the Union Army. He led the army to victory in the American Civil War in 1865.
